newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,498 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,498 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,498 contracts compared with 3,302 overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 19 wheat, 529 corn, 816 soybean, 96 soymeal, 37 soyoil, one oat, five soybean calls and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/2 to 2-1/2 cents higher, corn was 1-3/4 to 3-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were 2-1/4 to 4-1/4 cents higher.
